name: Perf Mode
description: Cuts frame cost in heavy levels by skipping off-screen objects, throttling decorative effects and keeping sprite data warm. Rendering only: level geometry, physics and timing are never touched.

enabled.name: Enable Perf Mode
enabled.description: Master switch. Turning this off restores stock rendering immediately.

cull-offscreen.name: Skip off-screen objects
cull-offscreen.description: Objects whose bounding box is fully outside the visible area are not submitted for drawing. They still exist, still collide and still count: only the draw call is skipped.

cull-margin.name: Culling margin (pixels)
cull-margin.description: Extra space around the screen that is kept drawn. Raise this if you see objects pop in at the edges; lower it for more savings.

skip-particles.name: Skip particles far off-screen
skip-particles.description: Particle systems that are completely outside the view are not updated or drawn. Particles you can see are unaffected.

skip-labels.name: Skip off-screen labels
skip-labels.description: Text labels outside the view are not drawn. Useful in levels that spam text triggers.

limit-particle-count.name: Cap visible particles
limit-particle-count.description: When a single particle system emits more particles than the cap, the extras are not drawn. The visual difference is minor; the cost saving is not.

particle-cap.name: Particle cap
particle-cap.description: Maximum particles drawn per emitter while the cap above is on.

warm-cache.name: Pre-warm sprite cache
warm-cache.description: Loads the sprite frames a level uses before it starts, which removes the first-attempt stutter caused by texture uploads.

show-stats.name: Show stats overlay
show-stats.description: Draws a small counter with drawn and skipped objects. Purely informational.

kill-switch.name: Key: toggle Perf Mode
kill-switch.description: Works inside a level. Immediately switches every optimization off or back on.
